name: Gaining Weight
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of overindulgence and excessive appetite, portraying gluttony as a sign of stubbornness and rebellion, as seen in Deuteronomy 21:20. The imagery of becoming 'fat' in Deuteronomy 32:15 symbolizes spiritual complacency and forsaking God. Proverbs further counsels self-control, urging restraint in eating and drinking to avoid the pitfalls of excess, emphasizing that too much of even good things like honey can lead to harm and dishonor.
